answer_1.quote: the goal of the proposed RAG framework is to generate a comprehensive response r_i that encompasses all plausible answers A_i = {a_i,1 , ..., a_i,M } of the interpretations Q_i = {q_i,1 , ..., q_i,M }
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses for ambiguous questions that cover all plausible interpretations and answers

answer_2.quote: Metrics for QA: ... we mainly adopt F1-based metric. Specifically, for the short-form QA dataset (SituatedQA) we measure F1 ... Given ASQA is the long-form QA dataset, following, we use Disambig-F1 (D-F1), which assesses the factual accuracy of long-form responses... We further leverage ROUGE-L (R-L) ... Finally, Disambiguation-ROUGE (DR), combines R-L and D-F1 scores...
